note: testOps(): self-checking EC identity suite — ecMulGen(1), ecNegate, ecMul(g,2n), ecAdd(g,g), ecPointX/Y round-trip through ecMakePoint, ecEncodeCompressed length — each guarded by assert(ecOnCurve(...)). Moved OUT of coverage-ledger.json: this fixture used to be executed by no engine, because ecMul(g,2n) returned the all-zero point and the ecOnCurve assert made the deployed script UNSPENDABLE (rejected on a live regtest node with 'Script failed an OP_VERIFY operation'). Fixed by replacing the incomplete Jacobian mixed-add with the RCB complete projective formulas.

spends.note: every EC identity holds on the real Spend engine; interpreter agrees

noRejectRationale: testOps() takes no arguments and reads no constructor state — pubKey is stored but never referenced by the method — so no input exists that could steer it to a rejection, and a fabricated reject would be theatre. The real negative for this fixture is a CODEGEN negative and is pinned as one: packages/runar-testing/src/__tests__/ec-mul-scalars.test.ts runs this same spend, and against the previous ec-codegen it fails with 'Script evaluation error: OP_VERIFY' — the same rejection the live node gave. That RED proof is what makes this accept meaningful.
